name: C.M.L. Metalworks LLC
old_description: Custom sheet metal fabrication is one of the most incredible parts of a build.
about:
C.M.L. Metalworks LLC was founded in 2011 in Vaughn, Montana. The company operates as a fabrication shop serving custom metalwork needs across the region.

The shop provides welding, sheet metal fabrication, CAD design, product testing, and full in-house manufacturing. Core specialties include custom aluminum fish hatchery tanks of various sizes for state agencies and large contractors, as well as stainless steel exhaust systems, fuel cells, plumbing, and electrical wiring for automotive builds. The team also fabricates roll cages, chassis, intake covers, radiator covers, roll pans, and motor mounts, drawing on over 15 years of experience in the hot rod and racing industry.

Customers range from state agencies requiring hatchery tanks to hot rod builders and race teams needing custom chassis and roll cages. Recent projects include a 500-gallon hatchery tank, a 25.5-certified roll cage for an S10 no-prep drag car, and a custom chassis for a Buick LS swap. The company also produces a line of custom Radio Flyer hot rod wagon chassis and bomber seats for retail sale.

The business emphasizes taking a project from concept to reality, handling design, testing, and production under one roof. Its founder highlights the creative potential of custom sheet metal work as a way to distinguish each build, and the shop's experience in the hot rod sector informs its approach to complex fabrication challenges.
